note: Prop textures (real photos + CC0 scans). *_n = OpenGL normal map, *_r = roughness. Tiles are seamless unless noted.

textures.name: bowl_rooster_side
textures.purpose: ชามตราไก่ rooster bowl: exterior side band (u = angle, v = rim->foot)
textures.notes: Conical (frustum) unwrap of a real rooster-bowl photo; covers ~130 deg — mirror/repeat for the back, or keep the rooster on the front. Inside of the bowl: plain white with a red rim line.

textures.name: cardboard
textures.purpose: corrugated cardboard + flattened brand cartons to sleep on (Mama noodles, Chang beer, plain)
textures.notes: cardboard_corrugated_tile: CC0 ambientCG Cardboard003. Sleeping mats: real carton prints (Mama, Chang) perspective-flattened from product photos, multiplied onto corrugated kraft, plus fold creases, dirt, grease rings and flip-flop prints (edited). cardboard_mat_plain has marker scribbles (Thai, looped handwriting font Sriracha). foam_mat_dirty: dirty styrofoam sheet.

textures.name: glass_grime
textures.purpose: grime overlay for the cart's glass display box (dust, fingerprints, grease smears, drips)
textures.notes: RGBA overlay built from CC0 ambientCG Fingerprints002, Smear002 and SurfaceImperfections003/015 masks; put on a second plane / decal over the glass. Alpha = grime amount.

textures.name: lpg_paint
textures.purpose: LPG cylinder painted steel (scratched enamel): red and World-Gas blue
textures.notes: CC0 ambientCG PaintedMetal004 (scratched red paint, silver scratches) and a hue-shifted blue; pair with img/labels/lpg_cylinder_world_gas.png for the logo band.

textures.name: melamine_plates
textures.purpose: melamine / ceramic plates (top view, alpha): rooster + green vine rim, floral rim, blue & white, plain white chipped
textures.notes: Real Thai plate photos rectified to circles. plate_white_chipped adds rim chips, cutlery scratches and curry stains (edited). Map planar onto the plate top; the rim fades to transparent outside the plate.

textures.name: plastic_film_clear
textures.purpose: clear PE/PP plastic bag film (ถุงแกง / ถุงร้อน, ice bags): crinkle highlights
textures.notes: From a real photo of clear plastic bags. PNG alpha = highlight/crinkle opacity (use with a transparent material, low opacity base); *_n = crinkle normal map.

textures.name: plastic_stool
textures.purpose: red / blue PP plastic (stools, tables, tubs) + real stool embossed band & logo
textures.notes: Colour from real Thai plastic stools; micro-surface from CC0 ambientCG Plastic010 (normal/roughness). stool_band_floral_*: cylindrical unwrap of a real stool's embossed floral band (red = hue-shifted). stool_logo_esqube.png: real moulded-in logo label (alpha).

textures.name: pp_woven_sack
textures.purpose: woven polypropylene sack fabric (rice / fertiliser sacks), white and natural
textures.notes: Seamless tile from a real woven-PP fabric macro photo (flat region, watermark excluded); *_natural = beige-green recycled-PP tint (fertiliser / market sacks).

textures.name: rice_cooker_body
textures.purpose: big commercial rice cooker body (white enamel, logo + switch)
textures.notes: Cylindrical unwrap (~130 deg front) of a real Sharp KSH-D1010 10 L commercial rice cooker.

textures.name: rubber_hose_orange
textures.notes: CC0 ambientCG Rubber004 surface recoloured to the orange of Thai low-pressure LPG hoses.

textures.name: stainless_brushed_dented
textures.purpose: brushed stainless steel with dents, scratches & grease (cart body, table top)
textures.notes: Base: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0 brushed-metal scan) + procedural dents/creases in the normal map + CC0 fingerprint/surface-imperfection grime. _n = OpenGL normal, _r = roughness. *_grimy = dirtier variant for the old cart (grease, water stains towards the bottom).

textures.name: styrofoam
textures.purpose: styrofoam (EPS) for food boxes, ice boxes, foam sheets
textures.notes: CC0 ambientCG Styrofoam004 (bead texture), slightly warmed.

textures.name: tamarind_board
textures.purpose: thick round tamarind-wood chopping board (เขียงไม้มะขาม): end-grain top (clean + used), side
textures.notes: Top: real tamarind board end grain (growth rings, off-centre pith) rectified to a circle, handle rivets inpainted. *_used: + knife scars, chop dents, damp dark centre, meat/chili stains (edited). Side: CC0 ambientCG Wood049 tinted to the tamarind sapwood colour (seamless).

textures.name: wok_black_exterior
textures.purpose: black pre-seasoned wok exterior (smooth carbonised steel)
textures.notes: Seamless tile from a real black carbon-steel wok product photo; lighting flattened.

textures.name: wok_carbon_interior
textures.purpose: seasoned carbon-steel wok interior: top-view disc + polar strip + patina tile
textures.notes: Real used carbon-steel wok (bronze/blue heat tint, dark seasoned centre). *_top.jpg: rim ellipse rectified to a circle (planar/disc UV). *_polar.jpg: u = angle 0-360 deg, v = radius (top row = centre, bottom = rim) — matches THREE.LatheGeometry UVs. *_tile.jpg: seamless patina. *_n.jpg normal maps (OpenGL).
